title: Framer Migration
meta: Move your site to Framer from Wix, WordPress, Squarespace or others with content and redirects carried over. From $200, in 7 days or less.
h1: Website migration to Framer, with redirects
overview: We rebuild your existing website in Framer and carry your content across. We copy pages, text, images and blog posts, move them into Framer layouts that match or improve your current look, and bring blog or portfolio entries into the CMS. We set up redirects from old addresses and copy search titles, so your links keep working. You review everything on a private preview before the domain moves.

faq: Which platforms can you move from?
Wix, WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, Weebly and plain HTML are common starting points. Send your link and we confirm what moves cleanly and what we rebuild by hand.
Will I lose my Google rankings?
We cannot promise rankings. We copy titles and descriptions, keep page addresses where we can and set 301 redirects, which gives search engines the best chance to follow along.
Framer is built for content sites, so it is not a full store platform. Tell us what you sell and we can suggest a light payment-link setup or a better platform.
Should I cancel my old site right away?
No. Keep it running until the Framer site is approved and live. We tell you when it is safe to cancel so your domain and email do not break.
